name: wormsign
description: Offline TypeScript scanning library and CLI gates for agent-driven npm/PyPI development. No npm runtime dependencies; one vendored, pinned, verified TOML parser, for the Python lockfiles soak reads and the pyproject.toml files diff compares.
author: stgllghr

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs
scripts.test:harden: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/test/harden.test.js dist/test/iocs-harden-agreement.test.js
scripts.check-files: node -e "const m = require('./package.json').files.filter((f) => !require('node:fs').existsSync(f)); if (m.length) { console.error('package.json files entries missing: ' + m.join(', ')); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check-files
